title: Review a change-password endpoint diff for security and correctness issues
description: Given a provided diff that adds a new 'change password' endpoint, perform a thorough code review identifying security and correctness issues (e.g. missing current-password verification, missing rate limiting, logging the new password, missing input validation, timing-unsafe comparison) and produce a structured review listing each issue, its severity, and a concrete suggested fix.
acceptanceCriteria: The review identifies the missing current-password verification before allowing a change.
The review identifies any instance where a plaintext password is written to logs.
The review identifies the use of a non-constant-time comparison for any secret/password comparison.
The review identifies missing input validation on the new password (e.g. minimum complexity/length) if absent from the diff.
Each identified issue includes a severity rating and a concrete, actionable suggested fix, not just a description of the problem.
verificationMethod: human-review (with llm-judge as a secondary, non-authoritative cross-check): the produced review is checked against a fixed reviewer checklist of the known-injected issues in the fixture diff.
groundTruth: The fixture diff contains five deliberately injected issues: missing current-password check, plaintext password logging, non-constant-time comparison, missing complexity validation, and missing rate limiting on the endpoint; a complete review identifies all five.
